clauses.why: Verse 19 alone gives the coming and the silver; verse 20 only tells how Menahem raised the money.
clauses.english: came against the land and was given a thousand talents of silver by Menahem
clauses.ukr: прийшов на край і отримав від Менахема тисячу талантів срібла
clauses.deu: kam ins Land und bekam von Menahem tausend Zentner Silber
clauses.spa: vino a la tierra y recibió de Manahem mil talentos de plata

clauses.why: The verse says God stirred up his spirit, but the singular 'he carried them away' does not clearly name Pul as the one who did it.
clauses.english: had his spirit stirred up by the God of Israel
clauses.deu: wurde im Geist vom Gott Israels erweckt
clauses.spa: tuvo su espíritu excitado por el Dios de Israel
